revision_scope: gen4und repository; source hashes also capture uncommitted changes

changes.vlmeval/config.py: Replace machine-specific BAGEL experiment registry with a portable entry and register BAGEL and custom UMM release adapters.
changes.run.py: Record completion/failures and isolate run directories for multi-seed aggregation; inference and scoring logic are retained.
changes.vlmeval/vlm/bagel_vlm.py: Use the supplied model path as the default base directory instead of a private filesystem path.
changes.setup.py: Use package metadata without a separate vendored README; release instructions live in the root README.
changes.vlmeval/api/gpt.py: Log the model name without API credentials or endpoint details.
changes.vlmeval/dataset/image_mcq.py: Accept explicit LLM-first judging for OmniTaskonomy and isolate its score caches from historical matching.
changes.vlmeval/dataset/utils/multiple_choice.py: Use LLM-first answer extraction when requested; fall back to exact matching only on API failure, with per-question logs.

selection: Tracked runtime source, assets, packaging, and historical BAGEL inference modules.
excluded: Documentation, Markdown documents, environment/credential files, results, predictions, weights, caches, Git metadata, notebooks, cluster launchers, and BAGEL training/evaluation extras.
